payload.claim: The three new tests in tests/test_task.py only ever construct `CellOutcome` with the default `reviews=[]` and `rebut_result=None`, so `concerns=anchored_concerns(outcome.reviews)`, `sustained=sustained_blockers(outcome.rebut_result)` and `unkept=unkept_fixes(outcome.rebut_result)` are exercised only in the all-zero case. Swapping the last two lines to `sustained=unkept_fixes(outcome.rebut_result), unkept=sustained_blockers(outcome.rebut_result),` keeps every assertion in tests/test_task.py green (both still evaluate to 0 with `rebut_result=None`), yet it would silently swap the level-3 sort ranking (`_SUSTAINED` in saffron/report/index.py) for every real unpackaged task with a settled rebuttal. No test in this diff asserts a non-zero value for any of these three fields.
